Hazrat Ali Murtaza (R.A) was the **Fourth Caliph**. Hazrat Ali Murtaza (R.A). He was born in the Holy City of Mecca about 30 years after the Prophet (S.A.W). He was the cousin brother of the Prophet (S.A.W), and was the first child to embrace Islam at the age of 10. Hazrat Ali (R.A) took part in many battles and fought very bravely in all the battles he took part in, thus being blessed with the title of “**Asaadullah**” (Lion of Allah). Hazrat Ali (R.A) became the Son in Law of the Prophet (S.A.W) by marrying His (S.A.W)’s youngest daughter **Sayyidah Bibi Fatima (R.A)**. At the age of 63, Hazrat Ali (R.A) was martyred whilst going to the Masjid.

entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: + 12.3 In Ali's hometown. # Muhammad Ali. **Muhammad Ali** (/ɑːˈliː/ *ah-LEE*; born **Cassius Marcellus Clay Jr.**; January 17, 1942 – June 3, 2016) was an American professional boxer and activist. In 1999, he was named Sportsman of the Century by *Sports Illustrated* and the Sports Personality of the Century by the BBC. During that year, he denounced his birth name as a "slave name" and formally changed his name to Muhammad Ali. In 1967, Ali refused to be drafted into the military, owing to his religious beliefs and ethical opposition to the Vietnam War, and was found guilty of draft evasion and stripped of his boxing titles. Ali fought in several highly publicized boxing matches, including fights with Liston, Joe Frazier (including the Fight of the Century, which at the time was the biggest boxing event, and the Thrilla in Manila), and George Foreman in The Rumble in the Jungle.
